Dahye · Listen & Shadow 10

At Your Desk — the wedding consultation
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
WELCOME
👤 Tom
Hi, I have an appointment at two.
안녕하세요, 2시에 예약했는데요.
appointment — 예약, 약속
💬 Dahye
Hello, you must be Mr. Tom. Please have a seat.
안녕하세요, Tom 님이시죠. 앉으세요.
you must be ~ — ~님이시죠 · have a seat — 앉다
같은 패턴으로 — You must be Ms. Lee. · Please have a seat here.
💬 Dahye
Can I get you coffee or tea?
커피나 차 드릴까요?
get someone ~ — ~에게 ~를 가져다주다
같은 패턴으로 — Can I get you some water? · Can I get you anything?
👤 Tom
I'm Tom. My fiancée couldn't come today.
저는 Tom이에요. 약혼자는 오늘 못 왔어요.
fiancée — 약혼녀
💬 Dahye
That's okay. Thank you for coming today.
괜찮아요. 오늘 와주셔서 감사해요.
that's okay — 괜찮아요
같은 패턴으로 — That's okay, no problem. · Thank you for coming in.
DATE AND SIZE
👤 Tom
Is May possible?
5월 가능해요?
possible — 가능한
💬 Dahye
Yes, May is possible. Which Saturday?
네, 5월 가능해요. 어느 토요일이요?
which — 어느
같은 패턴으로 — Yes, June is possible. · Which weekend?
👤 Tom
How many people can come?
몇 명까지 올 수 있어요?
how many — 몇 명
💬 Dahye
About two hundred people.
200명 정도요.
about — 대략
같은 패턴으로 — About fifty people. · About a hundred is fine.
👤 Tom
What floor is it on?
몇 층이에요?
floor — 층
💬 Dahye
It's on the third floor. Let me show you.
3층이에요. 보여드릴게요.
let me show you — 보여드릴게요
같은 패턴으로 — It's on the second floor. · Let me show you the photos.
FOOD AND PRICE
👤 Tom
How much is it for one person?
1인당 얼마예요?
for one person — 1인당
💬 Dahye
Just a moment, please. Let me check.
잠시만요. 확인해볼게요.
let me check — 확인해볼게요
같은 패턴으로 — Just a moment. · Let me check the price.
💬 Dahye
It's about ninety thousand won per person.
1인당 9만 원 정도예요.
per person — 1인당
같은 패턴으로 — It's about fifty thousand won per person. · It's ninety thousand, with food.
👤 Tom
Is food included?
음식 포함이에요?
included — 포함된
💬 Dahye
Yes, food is included. We can provide a buffet or a course.
네, 포함이에요. 뷔페나 코스로 준비해드려요.
provide — 준비해주다 · buffet — 뷔페 · course — 코스 요리
같은 패턴으로 — We can provide a vegetarian menu. · We can provide flowers too.
👤 Tom
Do you have vegetarian?
채식 메뉴 있어요?
vegetarian — 채식
💬 Dahye
Sorry — one more time?
죄송해요, 한 번만 더요?
one more time — 한 번 더
같은 패턴으로 — Sorry, one more time? · Sorry, could you say that again?
💬 Dahye
Yes, we do. We have a vegetarian menu.
네, 있어요. 채식 메뉴 있어요.
we do — 있어요 (Do you have ~?에 대한 답)
같은 패턴으로 — Yes, we do. · No, we don't, but we can prepare one.
CLOSING
👤 Tom
Can I send her the photos?
약혼자한테 사진 보내도 돼요?
send — 보내다
💬 Dahye
Yes, of course. I'll send them to you.
네, 그럼요. 제가 보내드릴게요.
of course — 그럼요
같은 패턴으로 — Yes, of course. · I'll send them today.
👤 Tom
Can I come back with her next week?
다음 주에 약혼자랑 다시 와도 돼요?
come back — 다시 오다
💬 Dahye
Yes, please. Any day is fine.
네, 오세요. 아무 날이나 괜찮아요.
any day — 아무 날이나
같은 패턴으로 — Any day is fine. · Any time after two is fine.
👤 Tom
Can I have your number?
연락처 주실 수 있어요?
number — 전화번호
💬 Dahye
Sure. Here's my card.
네. 제 명함이에요.
card — 명함
같은 패턴으로 — Here's my card. · Here's my number.
녹음 25/25
